title: CLARKSONS HELLAS - SnP WEEKLY
summary:
Main
Tanker rates remain at or near record highs as hopes of a reopening faded. President Trump rejected Iran's proposalto reopen the Strait, at least five tankers were struck in Hormuz this week, and the US is reported to be sending a third aircraft carrier to the region. VLCC earnings are averaging over USD 700,000 p/d on the Baltic Exchange's assessment, with Middle East Gulf-China voyages at USD 1.2 million p/d.
